operators.name: embedding_forward
semantics: Equivalent to nn.Embedding forward: out[b, s, d] = weight[indices[b, s], d]
No padding_idx, no scale_grad_by_freq, no sparse
Input indices must be on CUDA and int64; weight must be on CUDA and float32

operators.name: argsort_forward
semantics: Equivalent to torch.argsort(input, dim=1), with stable=False default
Sorts along the sequence dimension (dim=1), so each [seq_len, embedding_dim] slice for each batch is sorted independently
Indices returned are positions in the original sequence dimension
Ties may be broken arbitrarily as in torch.argsort (no stable guarantee)
Embedding lookup: x = weight[x[:, :]] with weight shape [1024,64] float32 and x shape [128,2048] int64
Output tensor shape [128,2048,64], dtype torch.float32, device cuda:0
No padding index; indices are within range [0,1023]
Sorts along dim=1 for each batch independently
For each batch b, each embedding dim d, sorts the values x[b,:,d] and returns indices
Output tensor shape [128,2048,64], dtype torch.int64, device cuda:0
Ties are broken by index order likely, but torch.argsort without stable does not guarantee
Returns the argsort result tensor [128,2048,64] int64 on cuda:0
